finding: ATM hook guidance emitted a `requiredCommand` containing `&&`, which fails in the current Windows PowerShell surface and repeats the exact shell-syntax class of dogfood failure the owner asked agents to avoid.
expectedBehavior: ATM guidance should emit Windows-safe command sequences or shell-specific variants instead of assuming POSIX/cmd-style command separators.
evidenceOrRepro: Reproduced on current HEAD: both the identity-check error details and pre-commit hook warning emitted a PowerShell-hostile `requiredCommand` containing `&&`. Added a focused regression that runs the hook on a staged file and asserts a single safe command plus an ordered `requiredCommands` array with no shell separator. `identity-command-windows-safe.test.ts`, the existing identity-check test, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `git diff --check`, and `npm run check:encoding:touched` all exit 0.
followUp: Keep `requiredCommands` as the canonical multi-step representation; future guidance must not reintroduce shell-specific command chaining into a copyable single command field.
